TestRepair::test_empty_vs_gcable_sequent.description: 2 nodes RF=2 (vnodes). cf1 gc_grace=1, cf2 default, compaction disabled. With node2 down, insert 10k rows in each table on node1 then delete them (partition + row tombstones); wait 2s; start node2, repair. Asserts no rows readable at CL=ALL. Intended (CASSANDRA-8979): empty vs gc-able tombstoned partitions considered in-sync, no repair for cf1.
